title: Transform arrays, maps and sets

outcomes.can: Trace selection and transformation and explain how a Set treats duplicates.

intro: A callback is a function passed to another function. The arrow t => t.open is a short function returning the open field. filter keeps items for which its callback returns true. map produces one output per retained item. A Set stores distinct values. A Map stores one current value per key. Use set(key, value) to update a Map, get(key) to read it, and ?? to supply a first count.

steps.title: Trace the example
steps.text: Filter preserves the original order. The second step then transforms each remaining task into a title. A repeated title remains present twice. When grouping by owner, a Set of seen names answers whether an owner occurred, while a Map from owner to count also records how often.

questions.prompt: Would a Set of the resulting titles keep both copies?

choices.text: Yes. Each input row creates a new entry.
choices.feedback: Different input rows can have equal title strings.

choices.text: No. Equal strings share one entry.
